title: Palo Alto Networks paid $500M for Thrive-backed Console, sources say | TechCrunch
summary: Palo Alto Networks paid $500 million in cash and stock to acquire Console, a two-year-old startup that uses AI agents to automate routine IT help desk tasks, according to two people with knowledge of the deal.
